description: Dependencies compiled into, used to build, or required at runtime by the JP6 (JetPack 6.x / L4T r36.5 / CUDA 12.6 / Python 3.10) candidate wheels. ORT fetch pins are the byte-for-byte values from cmake/deps.txt of the onnxruntime v1.23.2 source tree and match the 16 FetchContent components actually built into build-jp6-np2/Release/_deps (verified by directory listing). Runtime Python and ELF dependencies are also enumerated directly from each wheel by scripts/audit_jetson_wheels.py.
